messages:
isabel: Quick heads-up — noticed two confusing things in the /v1/generate docs during the quickstart check: curl and JS snippets show `Api-Key: <KEY>` while the REST reference uses `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`, and the example response mixes full sync JSON with SSE `delta` fragments. New users are failing the quickstart.

tarun: can you point to the exact files?

isabel: docs/api/auth.md, docs/samples/generate_sync_example.json, snippets/js/generate_quickstart.md, snippets/curl/generate.md. Also the openapi example example under docs/openapi/generate.yaml includes a `choices[].message.text` property but our runtime returns `choices[].message.content`.

lina: thanks. we should: 1) make `Authorization: Bearer` canonical in all primary examples, add a small "Legacy" note showing `Api-Key` header; 2) split the response examples into two: a Sync example with `choices[].message.content` and a Streaming SSE example demonstrating `data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}}]}` fragments; 3) fix OpenAPI sample to match `message.content`.

sdk-team-bot: FYI SDK owners: some older SDK versions still set `Api-Key` header by default. Recommend we add a one-line migration note and coordinate minor SDK doc updates.

tarun: i'll take the auth header edits and the migration note. i'll update curl, js, and python snippets to show `Authorization` first then legacy `Api-Key` collapsed.

isabel: i'll handle the OpenAPI sample and split the sync vs streaming examples. i'll also fix `temperature` sample which is currently a string "0.2" in generate_sync_example.json — schema validator flagged it.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint error in docs/samples/generate_sync_example.json line 14: type mismatch for `temperature` (expected number, got string).

lina: good catch. isabel please change to 0.2 (number). also add a short note in the top of generate.md: "Sync responses include full content in choices[].message.content; streaming responses use SSE delta fragments."

tarun: pushing branch `docs/generate-auth-syncstream-fix-1719876543` with commits `auth-examples`, `split-sync-stream-samples`, `fix-temperature-sample`. PR will be linked in a sec.

docs-bot: Preview build queued after push.

sdk-team-bot: Quick reminder: when you update examples in snippets/js, also update the README examples in the JS SDK repo to avoid mismatch during the next release.

isabel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — includes updated openapi sample, separate sync + streaming examples, and a short migration callout for `Api-Key`.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/5123 — build passed.

lina: reviewing now. small nit: in the SSE example please show explicit `data: [DONE]` termination line as we do in other docs.

isabel: updated SSE snippet to include final `data: [DONE]` chunk. pushed.

tarun: merged PR and added changelog entry: "docs: canonicalize auth header to Authorization; split sync and streaming generate examples; fix sample types"

isabel: verified quickstart passes on preview. thanks all — closing thread.
